newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Elephants run amok in Indonesia killing three.
newsitem.headline: Elephants run amok in Indonesia killing three.

text.p: Elephants rampaging through cultivated land in the Indonesian province of Lampung have killed three people, the official Antara news agency reported on Thursday.

"In the last month, in our region we have had three citizens killed when they were attacked by wild elephants," North Lampung's army commander, Lieutenant-Colonel S. Maksum, was quoted as telling reporters on Wednesday.
Maksum said two people were killed on Sunday and a third person was killed two weeks ago.

Elephants in Lampung, the southernmost province on the island of Sumatra, are encroaching on cultivated land because their natural forest habitat is being converted for farming. They are a protected species in Indonesia.
